verdict.rationale: Bun's package manager is itself an official first-party CLI, with extensive docs covering install, add, remove, update, outdated, why, audit, publish and the pm subcommands. Agent-friendly docs are confirmed by llms.txt and markdown probes, and community users confirm running it as a standalone package manager. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of agent-oriented CLI affordances such as machine-readable (JSON) output modes.
